hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom AMM hook backed by Euler Finance vaults. Executes swaps entirely in beforeSwap using a custom bonding curve (CurveLib), depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from EVC-managed Euler vaults, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard pool liquidity. Reverts on beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate to prevent non-productive positions.
